Lemma
[Smooth local orthonormal frames]

↗ def:riemannian-metric

Every $p$ has a neighborhood carrying a smooth orthonormal frame, whose members may be extended to smooth vector fields on $M$.
Proof

\sketch ↗ def:riemannian-metric

Apply fibrewise Gram–Schmidt to a coordinate frame. Smoothness follows because every normalization denominator is positive; multiply by a bump function equal to $1$ near $p$ to extend the fields globally.

□
